_PROJECT_HOOK: ===== PROJECT HOOK: map these preset knobs to YOUR device build flags/macros =====
_how_to_fill: entry_only compiles in ONLY the entry-rendezvous anchor (task example_entry_sync / sync_anchors.entry_rendezvous). It is the cheapest build that still yields a cross-rank + SW/HW alignment zero, and is the middle point of the overhead sweep. Fill compile_defines/compile_flags to gate everything except the entry anchor.
name: entry_only
description: Only the entry rendezvous anchor is recorded (one paired start/end per CTA on the dispatch track). Enough to align SW/HW and across ranks; negligible per-phase overhead.
_compile_defines_note: The KEYS are project hooks. A macro name that does not exist in your device source compiles cleanly and gates nothing: this preset would then record EVERY event instead of only the entry anchor, and the overhead sweep would report entry_only ~= full without any error. Grep the real guard names out of the device source.
_compile_flags_note: Empty only if no extra build args are needed. Verify by decoding an entry_only capture: it must contain exactly one paired anchor event per CTA on the dispatch track and nothing else.
_expected_overhead_note: Must be a measured number (full-vs-off style ratio for this preset), not a guess. A plausible-looking invented value reads like evidence in the delivered contract while proving nothing; leave the placeholder until you have actually run the sweep.
